description: RivalSweeper's analysis of a brand's customer reviews: recurring themes, sentiment, praise and complaints. Also the brand's rating history per review source over the last 26 weeks (Google Maps, Trustpilot, and what the brand's own site shows about itself, each kept apart and never mixed), with every read's link and date and the moves (a rating crossing 3.5 / 4.0 / 4.5 stars, a jump or drop in reviews).
